name: when2meet-mcp
description: Read and fill when2meet scheduling polls over plain HTTP — no browser required.
long_description:
MCP server for [when2meet](https://www.when2meet.com/) scheduling polls.

Paste a poll link and ask your assistant to mark your availability from a weekly schedule or calendar busy blocks. Uses when2meet's HTTP endpoints directly — no browser automation.

Recommended flow: `get_poll` → `fill_from_weekly_schedule` or `compute_availability_from_busy_times` (dry run) → `submit_availability`.

tools.name: get_poll
tools.description: Load a when2meet poll: title, participants, time range, and optional slot grid.

tools.name: find_common_availability
tools.description: Find time slots where at least N participants are free.

tools.name: fill_from_weekly_schedule
tools.description: Compute free slots from a recurring weekly busy schedule.

tools.name: compute_availability_from_busy_times
tools.description: Compute free slots from ISO calendar busy intervals.

tools.name: preview_availability
tools.description: Preview slot indices and bitmask without submitting.

tools.name: submit_availability
tools.description: Log in and save availability to when2meet.

agent_name.title: Agent display name
agent_name.description: Label used for alternate participant names (e.g. Claude, Composer).
